panels.title: Consolidation outcome over time
panels.description: consolidation_attempt_recorded outcomes (success/extraction_returned_fallback/budget_denied) over time, 90d/full history. Replaces the original "Dead-letter rate" panel, which was mislabeled -- dead_letter is not a real outcome value this event ever emits; the real signal it queried was extraction_returned_fallback. Critical timeline finding, verified against live ES weekly buckets: week of 2026-04-27 was 99.7% fallback (702/704, an acute incident), week of 05-04 shifted to 100% budget_denied/success (0 fallback), a two-week gap (05-11 to 05-18) had zero attempts, and every week since 2026-05-25 (5+ consecutive weeks) has been 100% success. A time-collapsed aggregate (46.3% fallback all-time) would misleadingly read as an active crisis; the time axis is what makes current health legible.

panels.title: Consolidation outcome totals
panels.description: Total consolidation_attempt_recorded outcomes (90d, full history -- 1517 attempts). See the Consolidation outcome over time panel before reading these totals in isolation: the 702 extraction_returned_fallback attempts are almost entirely from one resolved incident week (2026-04-27); the system has been 100% success for 5+ consecutive weeks since 2026-05-25.

panels.title: Top denial reason
panels.description: denial_reason breakdown for budget_denied consolidation attempts (90d, full history). cap_exceeded is 100% of denials (259/259) -- the auto-tuning monitor (FRE-311) should propose a cap raise if this stays saturated.

panels.title: Median attempts to success
panels.description: Median attempt_number for successful consolidation attempts, over time (90d, full history -- 556 successes; median=1, p90=2, p99=12, max=13 attempts). Dropped the original per-role breakdown: role is always entity_extraction (a single value across all 1517 attempts ever recorded), so the split added no information.
